items.title: Why Vertex Pharma Popped, As A Key Rival Plummeted 92%
items.summary: Vertex stock surged Monday after its competitor, Sionna Therapeutics, missed the mark for its highly anticipated cystic fibrosis treatment.

items.title: Why Sionna Therapeutics Stock Is Crashing 91% to a Record Low
items.summary: The biotech says its cystic fibrosis drug candidate missed the mark in a Phase 2a trial, though the news could be a boon to shares of Vertex Pharmaceuticals.

items.title: SION Stock On Track For Worst Day Ever After 90% Drop — What’s Driving The Selloff?
items.summary: Sionna said on Monday that its mid-stage trial of SION-719 in 15 adults with cystic fibrosis already taking Vertex’s Trikafta failed to meet its main goal.

items.title: This Biotech’s Drug Could Treat Hot Flashes. The Stock Is Up 34% on Good News.
items.summary: New data show a single dose of AbCellera’s menopause treatment, ABCL635, reduces how often patients with menopause experience hot flashes.

items.title: Vertex Stock Jumps 5.9% as Rival Cystic Fibrosis Drug Fails
items.summary: Sionna's disappointing trial removes an immediate competitive threat to the franchise generating most of Vertex's revenue.

items.title: Vertex Pharmaceuticals (VRTX) Is Up 5.4% After Raising 2026 Revenue Guidance And Expanding Its Pipeline - Has The Bull Case Changed?
items.summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals recently reported second-quarter 2026 results, with revenue rising to US$3,333.9 million and net income reaching US$1,099.8 million, and raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to US$13.10–US$13.20 billion. At the same time, a new collaboration with AbCellera on multispecific T‑cell engagers and a setback for a key cystic fibrosis competitor together highlight Vertex’s efforts to broaden its pipeline while easing pressure on its core franchise. items.title: Tenax, Sionna Shares Sink After Trial Failures
items.summary: Shares of Tenax Therapeutics and Sionna Therapeutics tumbled Monday after the biotechs revealed separate late-stage trial failures. Tenax stock fell nearly 90% after a Phase 3 trial of its experimental heart-failure pill failed to help patients walk farther than those on a placebo.

items.title: Sionna cystic fibrosis drug fails key trial, removing threat to Vertex
items.summary: Sionna’s medicine didn’t have a meaningful additive impact when combined with Vertex’s top-selling Trikafta, surprising analysts and collapsing company shares.
